title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
author: Samantha Shannon
summary: A divided world faces the return of an ancient, fiery enemy, as the east fears dragons and the west worships a hidden queen. The story follows a lady-in-waiting, a dragon-rider in training, a mage and a queen who must keep a secret.
readIf: you want a vast, standalone epic with dragons, queer love and a mostly female cast.
skipIf: you want a short or fast read, since it is very long and takes time to bring its threads together.

pairings.reason: Another enormous, immersive fantasy built on layered history and many viewpoints.
A shorter, racier dragon story if you want the same creatures with more romance and less politics.
A grimmer epic of dynasties and war with a similarly big cast.
